Definition: from G1909 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a looker-on:--eye-witness.
BiblicalUsage: epóptēs means a looker-on. It occurs just once, in 2 Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is to take epóptēs at face value and move on to the passage itself.
